alternates.name: Janet Dell
alternates.evidence_quote: In 2020, with events impacted by COVID-19, Freeman built on its 97-year history of industry stewardship by launching the Go LIVE Together coalition resulting in the formation of the Exhibitions and Conference Alliance. In 2021, Freeman joins Global Events Industry Leaders at COP26 and signs “Net Zero Carbon Events Pledge”. In 2023, Freeman acquired Sparks to maximize its ability to meet the needs of corporate customers everywhere. In 2024 Janet Dell becomes CEO, marking another exciting chapter
alternates.why_chosen: Principal / director (no Erasmus contact found). Janet Dell is stated to become CEO of Freeman Company.

contacts.rung: Principal / director (no Erasmus contact found). Buck Freeman is listed as the Founder of Freeman Company.
